$comment: Test cases for the document RAG pipeline (npm run eval). For answerable questions: expectedSource and expectedPassage say where the answer is (checks retrieval), mustInclude lists what the answer must say (each array inside is a list of acceptable alternatives). For questions the documents don't answer: expectRefusal.

cases.question: How many vacation days do I get per year?
Can I take unused vacation days into next year?
How much money can I spend on a desk and chair for working from home?
Who has to approve a 700 euro expense?
How long can I work from another country?
cases.expectedPassage: up to 30 days per calendar year
